summary: Iteration 6 (code-quality fixes: update_user hardening + useFetch deps). Backend: new suite test_gsb31_update_user_security.py, 20/20 pass. It covers: extra=forbid gives 422 on PATCH (token_version, password_hash, must_change_password, username, id, created_by), also when mixed with a valid field, and the DB doc is unchanged; extra fields on POST /users and reset-password give 422; role cycles ops->opfin->ops keep counters.ops == actual; duplicate email + role ops gives 409 and the counter does not leak; 3 rounds of 24 parallel ops<->opfin PATCHes return only 200/409 and the counter stays correct; ops limit 7 on role change (putri -> ops gives 409 at 7/7, freeing a slot works); deactivating a user revokes their session (401); role_changed and user_deactivated audit logs are written; director role/is_active changes give 400; director name/email edits work and spaces are collapsed; a name of only spaces gives 422; opfin/ops PATCH gives 403 DIRECTOR_ONLY. Regression, each suite run on its own with cleanup and a backend restart in between: test_gsb31_e2e 22/22, test_gsb31_weekly_templates 9/9. Frontend, Playwright on desktop: no repeated-fetch loop on any of 12 routes (each endpoint is called at most 2 times per mount, which is React.StrictMode in dev; 0 requests while idle). Data reloads after save on partner create, kopra create, document create + file upload (the sheet and the list both refetch), and Director accounts create/edit (name+role)/deactivate/activate. Audit log next/prev pages (skip=50) and the action filter refetch work. The dashboard loads with no console errors. The director edit dialog has no role select, and a spaces-only name shows the toast 'Nama minimal 2 karakter.'

issues: The success toast (top-right) partly covers the document title in the sheet header. Cosmetic, existed before this change.

critical_code_review_comments: update_user now filters the update on {id, role: target.role}. Side effect: an is_active-only or name-only PATCH that races with a role change returns 409 'Akun sedang diubah...'. This is acceptable and safe.
The order of strip_name vs Field(min_length=2) is fine: '   ' passes min_length but strip_name rejects it, so it returns 422. Max_length is checked before collapsing whitespace (harmless).

useFetch: when url becomes null, the effect returns early and loading stays true and the old data is not cleared. This is pre-existing and not a regression; DocSheet/PartnerSheet only show while id is set.
No caller passed the removed second deps argument to useFetch (checked with grep), so removing it does not change behavior.

Running the whole /app/backend/tests folder in one pytest session is NOT safe. test_gsb31_e2e fills the 10-account quota and does not clean up, so later suites (email_reports, update_user_security) fail with 409. Also, test_gsb31_email_reports sends REAL emails. Run each suite on its own and run cleanup_test_data.py plus a backend restart between suites.
